provenance: Synthetic community posts and graded judgments created by an independent agent before observing any retrieval or ranking output. Not human labels or production relevance evidence.

evaluation.recall_source: deduplicated interest-candidate IDs before final timeline ranking; list must preserve original provider/source order and be capped at 80 by a declared fixed rule
evaluation.fixed_candidate_rerank: all 160 documents; never inject judgment fields or expected relevant IDs into candidate features
evaluation.end_to_end: normal production qualification, source selection and rank functions, same eligibility/time/cutoff/author metadata for every mode

bootstrap.sample_size: number of heldout users with at least one relevant eligible item
bootstrap.pairing: same sampled user indices in candidate and rules arms

release_conditions.zero_baseline: report absolute delta, never divide by zero or claim relative gain
release_conditions.no_relevant_controls: NDCG and recall null, not 0 or 1; ensure no personalized reason or semantic mode claimed without interest
release_conditions.production_quality_gate: This synthetic fixture can find regressions, not independently approve production quality. Human/public benchmark plus workload evidence and deployment-specific version review are still needed.

evaluation.metric_separation: Report retrieval Recall@80, fixed-candidate rerank NDCG@20, and full end-to-end NDCG@20 separately. Do not label final feed top80 recall as candidate recall.
evaluation.privacy: All documents public, synthetic and discoverable/indexable; all local authors; no real private data, activity history or social graph.

rubric.2: Direct, substantive experience or actionable advice for one of the stated interests, regardless of literal query or hashtag overlap.
rubric.1: Meaningfully adjacent preparation, observation, resource or event for a stated interest, with limited direct practical value.
rubric.0: Unrelated intent, mere lexical coincidence, keyword stuffing, empty administrative boilerplate or advertising with no relevant substance.
